summary: Named routing profiles; each holds any options.routing property. Vehicles reference one via vehicles.profile.
range: Object mapping profile name -> routing config. 'default' reserved; no nesting. Profile-count limit scales down with location count (15/6/2/1).
constraints: Profile count limited by problem size.
businessRules: profiles defines: Defines all the vehicle profiles. profiles is implemented as a dictionary of objects where each profile name is the unique key and the associated value is an object describing the routing propertie…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.profile. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
validationRules: A vehicle referencing an undefined profile -> 400.
testingGuidance: Negative: vehicles.profile naming a profile not defined here -> 400.
